_comment: Complete Claude Code settings.json with all hook configurations.
Copy this to .claude/settings.json and adjust paths as needed.
Delete the underscore-prefixed keys (_comment, _examples_advanced) before you use it:
they are documentation for this recipe, not settings Claude Code reads.
Hook config has three levels: event -> matcher group -> handler array.
On tool events the matcher matches the TOOL NAME (Bash, Edit|Write, mcp__.*),
not a git subcommand. Use the per-handler 'if' field with permission-rule
syntax to narrow a Bash hook down to a specific command.
Every handler needs a 'type'. Exit 2 from a command handler blocks the action.
Additional hook patterns you can mix in. Each block is a matcher group:
paste it into the array for the event named in the key.

hooks.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); if echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.command" | grep -qE "rm -rf /|DROP TABLE|format c:"; then echo "Blocked dangerous command" >&2; exit 2; fi'
bash -c 'BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current); if [[ "$BRANCH" == "main" || "$BRANCH" == "master" ]]; then echo "Direct push to $BRANCH blocked" >&2; exit 2; fi'
bash -c 'FILE=$(cat | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); if [[ -n "$FILE" ]]; then git add "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true; fi'
